verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's source is publicly readable in a first-party GitHub repository (Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm), with a public releases/commit history and free Docker self-hosting, so the readable-source half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OSI-approved/open license, docs stating license terms, independent corroboration of license openness.
